name: JKN audit copilot, golden set v1
notes: Questions an auditor asks the JKN copilot (Bahasa Indonesia). Numbers are checked against live truth: the runner reads them from the same platform API as the signed-in user at run time, so the set stays right when the demo data changes. must_call: at least one of these tools must be called successfully. truth: every value must appear in the answer. must_say_any: at least one phrase must appear. Wording of the questions and expected phrases is to be reviewed by a BPJS auditor.
